notes: A is the only fixed robot-frame point: A=(0,0). All other points are derived from lengths, directed angles, topology and the current linkage configuration.
The directed vector D->A has angle -30 degrees from +Ox; therefore A->D is the opposite direction.
The linkage configuration q is the directed counter-clockwise angle from A->B to D->A. Therefore theta_AB = theta_DA - q.
Point D is derived from A, AD and theta_AD. Point B is derived from A, AB and theta_AB.
Point C is selected from the intersection of the circle centered at B with radius BC and the circle centered at D with radius CD, using the configured physical side of directed B->D.
B, C and O are fixed material points of one rigid wheel-carrier body.
H and O are derived from the moving B->C basis: e_BC=(C-B)/BC, H=B-BH*e_BC, and O=H+OH*n_BC on the configured side of B->C.
H is an auxiliary construction point, not a joint or degree of freedom.
No mirror, solver-frame rotation, display correction, or fixed coordinates for B/C/D/H/O are part of the physical model.
